#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
DB=appdb; OLD_TABLE=users; NEW_TABLE=users_new; TEMP_TABLE=users_old
PG_PORT=5432
echo '=== Create new table with extended schema ==='
sudo -u postgres psql -p $PG_PORT -d $DB -c "
CREATE TABLE $NEW_TABLE (LIKE $OLD_TABLE INCLUDING ALL);
ALTER TABLE $NEW_TABLE ADD COLUMN email_verified BOOLEAN DEFAULT false;
"
echo '=== Create sync trigger on old table ==='
sudo -u postgres psql -p $PG_PORT -d $DB -c "
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sync_users_fn() RETURNS TRIGGER AS \$\$
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN
    INSERT INTO $NEW_TABLE SELECT NEW.*, false;
    RETURN NEW;
  ELSIF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN
    DELETE FROM $NEW_TABLE WHERE id = NEW.id;
    INSERT INTO $NEW_TABLE SELECT NEW.*, COALESCE(NEW.email_verified, false);
    RETURN NEW;
  ELSIF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
    DELETE FROM $NEW_TABLE WHERE id = OLD.id;
    RETURN OLD;
  END IF;
END;
\$\$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

CREATE TRIGGER sync_users_trigger
AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON $OLD_TABLE
FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION sync_users_fn();
"
echo '=== Backfill existing data in batches ==='
sudo -u postgres psql -p $PG_PORT -d $DB -c "
INSERT INTO $NEW_TABLE SELECT *, false FROM $OLD_TABLE WHERE id > 0 AND id <= 10000;
"
# Continue in batches
sudo -u postgres psql -p $PG_PORT -d $DB -c "
DO \$\$DECLARE max_id INT; BEGIN
  SELECT COALESCE((SELECT MAX(id) FROM $OLD_TABLE), 0) INTO max_id;
  FOR i IN 0..max_id BY 10000 LOOP
    INSERT INTO $NEW_TABLE SELECT *, false FROM $OLD_TABLE WHERE id > i AND id <= i + 10000
    ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;
    COMMIT;
  END LOOP;
END;\$\$;"
echo '=== Create indexes on new table ==='
sudo -u postgres psql -p $PG_PORT -d $DB -c "CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS idx_users_new_email ON $NEW_TABLE (email);"
echo '=== Swap tables ==='
sudo -u postgres psql -p $PG_PORT -d $DB -c "
ALTER TABLE $OLD_TABLE RENAME TO $TEMP_TABLE;
ALTER TABLE $NEW_TABLE RENAME TO $OLD_TABLE;
"
echo 'Zero-downtime migration complete'

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

TS=$(date); LOG=/var/log/db_maintenance_$(date +%Y%m%d).log
WEBHOOK=https://hooks.slack.com/services/T00/B00/xxx
notify() { curl -s -X POST $WEBHOOK -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"text":"['$1'] '$2'"}' --connect-timeout 5 & }

notify START "Database maintenance starting on $(hostname)" | tee -a $LOG

# PostgreSQL maintenance
if systemctl is-active postgresql >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "=== PG: Set read-only ===" | tee -a $LOG
  sudo -u postgres psql -c "ALTER SYSTEM SET default_transaction_read_only = on; SELECT pg_reload_conf();"
  echo "=== PG: VACUUM ANALYZE ===" | tee -a $LOG
  sudo -u postgres vacuumdb --all --analyze -j4 2>&1 | tee -a $LOG
  echo "=== PG: REINDEX ===" | tee -a $LOG
  sudo -u postgres reindexdb --all -j4 2>&1 | tee -a $LOG
  echo "=== PG: Set read-write ===" | tee -a $LOG
  sudo -u postgres psql -c "ALTER SYSTEM SET default_transaction_read_only = off; SELECT pg_reload_conf();"
fi

# MySQL maintenance
if systemctl is-active mysql >/dev/null 2>&1 || systemctl is-active mariadb >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "=== MySQL: Set read-only ===" | tee -a $LOG
  mysql -u root -e "SET GLOBAL read_only=ON;"
  echo "=== MySQL: mysqlcheck ===" | tee -a $LOG
  mysqlcheck -u root --auto-repair --all-databases 2>&1 | tee -a $LOG
  echo "=== MySQL: Set read-write ===" | tee -a $LOG
  mysql -u root -e "SET GLOBAL read_only=OFF;"
fi

notify DONE "Database maintenance complete" | tee -a $LOG
echo "Log: $LOG"
DBA

echo 'Maintenance window automation script installed'
